Shift.Name: Shift
Shift.Description: Toggle the Shift state of the calculator. Press Shift then the target button to use the function specified by the yellow text.

Alpha.Name: Alpha
Alpha.Description: Toggle the Alpha state of the calculator. Press Alpha then the target button to use the function specified by the red text.

Mode.Name: Mode
Mode.Description: Open the Mode menu to switch to other modes.
Mode.Warning: Only the Compute mode is currently implemented.

Shift-Mode.Name: Setup
Shift-Mode.Description: Open the Setup menu to change calculator settings. Contains angle mode and output mode settings.

Abs.Name: Abs
Abs.Description: Calculate the absolute value of an expression.

Cube.Name: $x^3$
Cube.Description: Calculate the third power of an expression.

Alpha-Cube.Description: Input multiple expressions and calculate them in order.

Sin.Name: sin
Sin.Description: Calculate the sine of an expression. Depends on angle mode.

Cos.Name: cos
Cos.Description: Calculate the cosine of an expression. Depends on angle mode.

Tan.Name: tan
Tan.Description: Calculate the tangent of an expression. Depends on angle mode.
